mapper.sql: query_id, job_id, segment_index, user_id, user_name, prefix_sql, sql_content, sql_hash, sql_type, has_result_set, affected_rows, engine_params, status, stage, cancel_requested, cancel_requested_time, fail_stage, fail_reason_category, error_code, error_message, engine_type, engine_instance, executor_instance, processing_server_instance, reused_from_task_id, scan_rows, scan_bytes, persistent_log_path, enqueue_time, start_time, fetch_start_time, write_start_time, local_write_finish_time, oss_upload_time, finish_time, duration_ms, is_deleted, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO adhoc_query_task (query_id, job_id, segment_index, user_id, user_name, prefix_sql, sql_content, sql_hash, sql_type, has_result_set, status, fail_stage, fail_reason_category, error_code, error_message, engine_type, engine_instance, executor_instance, processing_server_instance, enqueue_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{t.queryId}, #{t.jobId}, #{t.segmentIndex}, #{t.userId}, #{t.userName}, #{t.prefixSql}, #{t.sqlContent}, #{t.sqlHash}, #{t.sqlType}, #{t.hasResultSet}, #{t.status}, #{t.failStage}, #{t.failReasonCategory}, #{t.errorCode}, #{t.errorMessage}, #{t.engineType}, #{t.engineInstance}, #{t.executorInstance}, #{t.processingServerInstance}, #{t.enqueueTime}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT executor_instance FROM adhoc_query_task WHERE status IN ('RUNNING','PENDING') AND is_deleted=0 AND executor_instance IN (SELECT instance_id FROM adhoc_executor_instance WHERE status='DOWN')
mapper.update: UPDATE adhoc_query_task SET status='FAILED', fail_reason_category='EXECUTOR_CRASHED', fail_stage='EXECUTING', error_code='ADHOC_EXECUTOR_CRASHED', finish_time=NOW() WHERE executor_instance=#{exec} AND status='RUNNING'
UPDATE adhoc_query_task SET status='FAILED', fail_reason_category='SKIPPED_DUE_TO_SESSION_LOSS', fail_stage='DISPATCH', finish_time=NOW() WHERE executor_instance=#{exec} AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE adhoc_query_task SET status='FAILED', fail_reason_category='TASK_LOST', fail_stage='EXECUTING', finish_time=NOW() WHERE query_id=#{queryId} AND status='RUNNING'
mapper.select: SELECT query_id FROM adhoc_query_task WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND sql_hash = #{sqlHash} AND status = 'SUCCESS' AND finish_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{ttlSeconds} SECOND) AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY finish_time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT status, fail_reason_category FROM adhoc_query_task WHERE job_id = #{jobId} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT status AS status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM adhoc_query_task WHERE enqueue_time >= #{startTime} AND enqueue_time <= #{endTime} AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY status
SELECT fail_stage AS failStage, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM adhoc_query_task WHERE enqueue_time >= #{startTime} AND enqueue_time <= #{endTime} AND is_deleted = 0 AND status = 'FAILED' GROUP BY fail_stage

SELECT error_code AS errorCode, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM adhoc_query_task WHERE enqueue_time >= #{startTime} AND enqueue_time <= #{endTime} AND is_deleted = 0 AND status = 'FAILED' AND error_code IS NOT NULL AND error_code <> '' GROUP BY error_code ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT sql_type AS sqlType, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM adhoc_query_task WHERE enqueue_time >= #{startTime} AND enqueue_time <= #{endTime} AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY sql_type

SELECT COALESCE(processing_server_instance, '(未分配)') AS instance, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM adhoc_query_task WHERE enqueue_time >= #{startTime} AND enqueue_time <= #{endTime} AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY processing_server_instance

SELECT COALESCE(executor_instance, '(未分配)') AS instance, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM adhoc_query_task WHERE enqueue_time >= #{startTime} AND enqueue_time <= #{endTime} AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY executor_instance

SELECT hour AS hour, SUM(isSubmitted) AS submitted, SUM(isFinished) AS finished FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(enqueue_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00') AS hour, 1 AS isSubmitted, 0 AS isFinished FROM adhoc_query_task WHERE enqueue_time >= #{startTime} AND enqueue_time <= #{endTime} AND is_deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT DATE_FORMAT(finish_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00'), 0, 1 FROM adhoc_query_task WHERE finish_time >= #{startTime} AND finish_time <= #{endTime} AND is_deleted = 0 AND status IN ('SUCCESS','FAILED','CANCELED') UNION ALL SELECT DATE_FORMAT(#{startTime}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00'), 0, 0 UNION ALL SELECT DATE_FORMAT(#{endTime}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00'), 0, 0 ) t WHERE hour IS NOT NULL GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour

SELECT hour AS hour, SUM(isSubmitted) AS submitted, SUM(isFinished) AS finished FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(enqueue_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS hour, 1 AS isSubmitted, 0 AS isFinished FROM adhoc_query_task WHERE enqueue_time >= #{startTime} AND enqueue_time <= #{endTime} AND is_deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT DATE_FORMAT(finish_time, '%Y-%m-%d'), 0, 1 FROM adhoc_query_task WHERE finish_time >= #{startTime} AND finish_time <= #{endTime} AND is_deleted = 0 AND status IN ('SUCCESS','FAILED','CANCELED') UNION ALL SELECT DATE_FORMAT(#{startTime}, '%Y-%m-%d'), 0, 0 UNION ALL SELECT DATE_FORMAT(#{endTime}, '%Y-%m-%d'), 0, 0 ) t WHERE hour IS NOT NULL GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour
